steps.name: Epilogue ~ Plan B
steps.objective: A strange wind blows in front of [Feta] in 「Orcarium」.

lines.text: (A fierce whirlwind sweeps in from nowhere and shakes the area before Orcarium Camp.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: What is this wind? I have a bad feeling... I always seem to be right at times like this.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That is...
(Spotting something in the sky, Feta tears pages from his spellbook and chants. Magic circles appear around him.)
(But an incoming magic golem’s attack obliterates the circles in an instant.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: So this is why all the other mages refused to come. Nothing for it, then.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Time to run.
(Feta turns to flee, only to stop in his tracks.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Hello...? What do you mean, hello? Licaria, grab this mage!
(At No Name’s command, Licaria seizes Feta and lifts him into the air.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Ugh... S-stop!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Answer my questions, and I will let you live.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You expect me to believe that?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Believe it or do not. Your choice.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: A-all right. What do you want to know?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How did I come back to life?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: How should I know? Your magic has been resonating this whole time. You died? What are you talking about? Dead people do not give off magic...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Then I really am alive now...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Next question!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Tell me everything you know about the witches. I know a witch left some sort of mark on you.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Was that not all over?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Start talking.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: At the Magic Bureau, a woman who called herself a witch asked me to become her servant.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: When I refused, she told me to give that adventurer a piece of paper. That is all.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: That woman’s name... Do you remember her face and name?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I do not know...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: All I remember is that a mage called Zephyros was there. Everything else is gone.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You lost your memories after all.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: If I knew anything, would I have come all the way out here to do this job?!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Fair point.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: But is there nothing else? About the Magic Bureau’s experiments, for instance...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Experiments...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I will not kill you. The witch did not kill you either, after all.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Ngh...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: There are many experiments, but one took priority over the rest. Something to do with souls...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Moving them between different bodies, merging them...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Get to the point.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Both your soul and your body...
(After hearing the whole story, No Name looks satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Let me go now... I do not want to be this high up... What is that look? W-why are you making that face...?
(Feta notices the subtle change in No Name’s expression and recoils.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Licaria.
(At the sound of its name, Licaria turns toward No Name. No Name smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Time for Plan B. In other words, we are going witch hunting. Sounds fun, does it not?
